# Gemini Image Segmentation (Secondary LLM Index)

Primary agent entrypoints:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/DOCUMENTATION_MAP.md
- docs/ENGINEERING_QUICKSTART.md
- docs/SETUP.md
- README.md

Default execution rules:
- Use `conda run -n gemini_seg ...` for Python and `pytest` commands.
- Use bash/WSL for normal shell work; use PowerShell only for `.ps1` scripts.
- The direct CLI does not auto-load `.env`.
- `scripts/launch_batch.sh` and `scripts/run_polyp_full_3x3_w10.ps1` do auto-load `.env`.
- Use subagents when helpful, but keep patches minimal and behavior-preserving.

Read by scope:
- Setup/bootstrap: `docs/SETUP.md`
- Runtime: `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`
- Batch: `docs/BATCH_ORCHESTRATION.md`
- Methods/manuscript: `docs/MANUSCRIPT_ALIGNMENT.md`, `docs/METHODS_CHANGELOG.md`
- Notebooks: `docs/NOTEBOOKS.md`
- NanoBanana: `docs/NANOBANANA_STUDY.md`, `src/nanobanana_segmentation/AGENTS.md`
- Operational snapshots: `docs/AGENT_HANDOFF.md`, `docs/GEMINI_CACHING.md`
- History only: `docs/history/VALIDATION_SNAPSHOTS.md`
